messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The loan approval process starts by receiving a customer request for a loan amount. The risk assessment Web service is invoked to assess the request. If the loan is small and the customer is low risk, the loan is approved. If the customer is high risk, the loan is denied. If the customer needs further review or the loan amount is for $10,000 or more, the request is sent to the approver Web service. The customer receives feedback from the assessor or approver.

      <outgoing>Flow_1</outgoing>
    </startEvent>

    <task id="Task_AssessRisk" name="Invoke Risk Assessment Web Service">
      <incoming>Flow_1</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_2</outgoing>
    </task>

    <exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RiskDecision" name="Risk Assessment Result?">
      <incoming>Flow_2</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_Approve</outgoing>
      <outgoing>Flow_Deny</outgoing>
      <outgoing>Flow_SendApprover</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <task id="Task_ApproveLoan" name="Approve Loan">
      <incoming>Flow_Approve</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_ApproveToMerge</outgoing>
    </task>

    <task id="Task_DenyLoan" name="Deny Loan">
      <incoming>Flow_Deny</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_DenyToMerge</outgoing>
    </task>

    <task id="Task_SendToApprover" name="Send Request to Approver Web Service">
      <incoming>Flow_SendApprover</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_3</outgoing>
    </task>

    <exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ApproverDecision" name="Approver Decision?">
      <incoming>Flow_3</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_ApproverApprove</outgoing>
      <outgoing>Flow_ApproverDeny</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <task id="Task_ApproverApprove" name="Approver Approves Loan">
      <incoming>Flow_ApproverApprove</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_ApproverApproveToMerge</outgoing>
    </task>

    <task id="Task_ApproverDeny" name="Approver Denies Loan">
      <incoming>Flow_ApproverDeny</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_ApproverDenyToMerge</outgoing>
    </task>

    <exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Merge" name="Merge Outcomes">
      <incoming>Flow_ApproveToMerge</incoming>
      <incoming>Flow_DenyToMerge</incoming>
      <incoming>Flow_ApproverApproveToMerge</incoming>
      <incoming>Flow_ApproverDenyToMerge</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_4</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <task id="Task_SendFeedback" name="Send Feedback to Customer">
      <incoming>Flow_4</incoming>
      <outgoing>Flow_5</outgoing>
    </task>

    <endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="Process Completed">
      <incoming>Flow_5</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <!-- Sequence Flows -->
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_AssessRisk" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_AssessRisk" targetRef="Gateway_RiskDecision" />

    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approve" name="Small loan & Low risk" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskDecision" targetRef="Task_ApproveLoan">
      <conditionExpression xsi:type="tFormalExpression">loanAmount < 10000 AND riskLevel == 'Low'</conditionExpression>
    </sequenceFlow>

    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deny" name="High risk" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskDecision" targetRef="Task_DenyLoan">
      <conditionExpression xsi:type="tFormalExpression">riskLevel == 'High'</conditionExpression>
    </sequenceFlow>

    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendApprover" name="Further review needed OR amount >= 10000" sourceRef="Gateway_RiskDecision" targetRef="Task_SendToApprover">
      <conditionExpression xsi:type="tFormalExpression">riskLevel == 'FurtherReview' OR loanAmount >= 10000</conditionExpression>
    </sequenceFlow>

    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApproveToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ApproveLoan" targetRef="Gateway_Merge" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_DenyToMerge" sourceRef="Task_DenyLoan" targetRef="Gateway_Merge" />

    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SendToApprover" targetRef="Gateway_ApproverDecision" />

    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApproverApprove" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ApproverDecision" targetRef="Task_ApproverApprove">
      <conditionExpression xsi:type="tFormalExpression">approverDecision == 'Approved'</conditionExpression>
    </sequenceFlow>

    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApproverDeny" name="Denied" sourceRef="Gateway_ApproverDecision" targetRef="Task_ApproverDeny">
      <conditionExpression xsi:type="tFormalExpression">approverDecision == 'Denied'</conditionExpression>
    </sequenceFlow>

    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApproverApproveToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ApproverApprove" targetRef="Gateway_Merge" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApproverDenyToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ApproverDeny" targetRef="Gateway_Merge" />

    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_Merge" targetRef="Task_SendFeedback" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_SendFeedback" targetRef="EndEvent_1" />
